correctness.rationale: For the symmetric irreducible kernel, the weighted Laplacian has kernel exactly the constants; the inverse trace on their orthogonal complement is the zero-diagonal Kemeny sum. Periodicity adds no exception. The resistance pair sum counts four copies of each core pair and 2m-1 contributions from each pendant bridge; dividing by 2m gives the asserted trace formula, including when the positive core support is a connected subgraph. For a positive definite Q the inverse-trace second variation in a nonzero symmetric direction D is twice tr(S²Q^-1)>0 with S=Q^-1/2 D Q^-1/2. Averaging over core automorphisms extended to the leaves therefore preserves the mean pendant rate and improves strictly unless the kernel was invariant. At fixed invariant pendant rate a, increasing the common core rate to (1-a)/d strictly improves the cost unless already saturated. Irreducibility gives 0<a<1. Thus the exact constrained minimum is B/(1-a)+C/a, and completing the square gives precisely the displayed regret and its sharp equality case. The cyclic specialization follows from the reciprocal Laplacian sum; for example the equal-edge cost is (3/2)B+3C, giving the stated polynomial and limiting ratio.
residual_risks: No extension to nonuniform stationary distributions or nonsymmetric kernels is certified.
